> Using `gh` or a coding agent? GitHub CLI v2.99+ supports `gh pr create --attach ./demo.mp4` and `gh pr edit <number> --attach ./demo.mp4`. Repeat `--attach` for multiple files. CLI uploads require repository write access; otherwise, attach through GitHub's web UI. [Attachment guide](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/).
